text:
Claire J: Quick flag  noticed a cohort of mid-market accounts lost ~0.6 health pts overnight after the nightly scoring job. Renewal risk alerts spiked. Anyone else seeing a pattern?
Marco F: Yep, I saw it on the health dashboard. The anomaly maps to accounts with recent 'demo_complete' events. Their contribution to the score dropped.
Isha V: That aligns with the recent scoring tweak in compute_healthscore v2.4  PR #778 lowered demo_complete weight from 1.4 -> 0.6 to reduce overrating trials. Might have been too aggressive for mm tier.
Claire J: Do we have a quick detection query to list affected accounts? Need to triage which owners to notify.
analytics-bot: Suggested query:
```
SELECT a.id, a.company, old_score, new_score, (old_score - new_score) AS delta
FROM healthscore_audit ha
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = ha.account_id
WHERE ha.snapshot_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND ha.old_score - ha.new_score > 0.3
  AND a.tier = 'mid-market'
LIMIT 200;
```
Marco F: Running the query in analytics now. Early sample: 184 accounts >0.3 drop, cluster around product-led trials that recently had demos.
Isha V: Two mitigation tracks: 1) quick back-configuration to revert demo weight for mid-market to 1.2 and run a targeted recompute, 2) longer-term: make weight a tunable per-tier with safe defaults and rollout via playbook so changes include backfill steps.
Claire J: Prefer minimal blast radius: target recompute for mid-market only. Can ops run a sandbox recompute and provide diffs?
ops-bot: queued job 'sandbox-health-recompute-2766004321' requested by Claire J. ETA 30m. Dry-run will write diffs to s3://cs-audit/dryruns/2766004321.json
Marco F: Patch I tested in staging: set demo_weight = CASE WHEN tier='mid-market' THEN 1.2 ELSE 0.6 END; then recompute from event_ledger for last 3 years. SQL snippet:
```
WITH events AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='demo_complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS demos
  FROM account_events
  WHERE occurred_at > now() - interval '3 years'
  GROUP BY account_id
)
UPDATE accounts a
SET healthscore = compute_healthscore(a.base_score, events.demos, other_params)
FROM events
WHERE a.id = events.account_id AND a.tier = 'mid-market';
```
Isha V: Good. Add telemetry: cs.health.recompute.attempt, cs.health.recompute.delta.p50 and tag by tier and change_id so we can trace. Also safety-latch: abort if >2% of affected accounts have missing contact info after recompute.
Claire J: Also need a CS-facing note template for owners explaining score change and that it's a tuning rollback, not a behavior drop. I'll draft.
Marco F: Sandbox run complete: 184 candidates recomputed, median delta +0.42 for affected accounts, no nulls. Diffs stored at s3 path.
ops-bot: scheduled prod canary 'prod-health-recompute-canary-2766004321' 1% cohort at 2025-09-10T03:00Z.
Isha V: I'll open a playbook PR to make scoring weights configurable per-tier and include an automated backfill step when weights change. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/778-reweight-backfill
Claire J: Plan: run 1% canary -> 10% -> 100% over 6h, monitor cs.health.recompute.delta.p50 and renewal-alerts.count. Rollback if error rate >0.5% or median unexpected delta >0.6. Marco, can you own the canary watch?
Marco F: On it. I'll stream diffs to the shared dashboard and ping owners for any surprises.
Claire J: Thanks. After canary, we'll update the healthscore docs and add a short note in CS ops board about per-tier weights. Closing thread once prod recompute finishes. :white_check_mark:
